slides.0.title: Course Introduction
slides.0.content: Loire Crémant & Saumur Sparkling — This course covers Crémant-de-Loire and Saumur (sparkling), exploring the geography, soils, varieties, and style characteristics of these AOCs.
slides.1.title: Loire Crémant & Saumur Sparkling
slides.1.content:
This course provides a systematic study of the terroir of Crémant-de-Loire and Saumur (sparkling), helping you build a solid knowledge framework for the Loire Valley.

Through systematic learning, you will be able to identify the typical styles of these AOCs and accurately describe their characteristics during tasting.
slides.3.title: Quiz
slides.3.questions.0.question: Which of the following AOCs is covered in this course?
slides.3.questions.0.explanation: Crémant-de-Loire is an important AOC in the Loire Valley and the core subject of this course. It produces sparkling wines using the traditional method across the Loire region.
